hint.relay.reset: The main relay tripped. Reset it at the breaker wall (Power and oxygen room, to the south).
hint.filter.swap: The CO₂ filter is running out. Swap it at the scrubber in the Power and oxygen room.
solar.mode.manual: MANUAL mode: turn the panels with ◀ ▶ (free, but you have to keep an eye on them)
solar.mode.auto: AUTO mode: the panels follow the Sun by themselves
solar.auto_cost: «Auto»: its motor uses {kw} kW while the Sun is up (≈ {kwh} kWh per sol). Turning by hand is free, but you have to come back every few hours.
energy.info.general: General outreach: typical values, not measured in this base. Game time is accelerated.
energy.breakers.msg_burned: Relay burned! Bring the screwdriver and 1 spare part
energy.breakers.msg_overload: Using too much! Switch something off
energy.breakers.msg_low: Battery low: switch off what you don't need
energy.info.breakers.title: POWER GRID · HOW IT WORKS
energy.info.breakers.1: Now: generating {gen} kW (RTG {rtg} kW always + solar panels by day) and using {use} kW. Battery: {kwh} of {max} kWh.
energy.info.breakers.2: Bus limit: {limit} kW. Stay above it for a few minutes and the main relay trips to protect the cables. If it trips {trips} times in a day, it burns.
energy.info.breakers.3: When power runs short, circuits are cut by priority: the last one on the list goes off first.
energy.info.breakers.battery: If the base produces more than it uses, the extra charges the battery; if it uses more, the battery drains. To charge it faster: switch circuits off, turn the panels to the Sun and clean them.
energy.info.breakers.ls_kw: depends on what runs (electrolyzer {e} kW + scrubber {s} kW)
energy.info.breakers.rtg: An RTG turns the heat of decaying plutonium-238 into electricity. The Curiosity and Perseverance rovers each carry one.
energy.info.ls.title: LIFE SUPPORT · DATA
energy.info.ls.1: Electrolyzer: splits water with electricity (2 H₂O → 2 H₂ + O₂). Here it makes +{o2} % O₂ per hour and uses {water} L of water per hour; the crew uses {use} %/h.
energy.info.ls.2: Scrubber: a filter traps the CO₂ we breathe out (+{co2} ppm/h). With a filter and power it removes {scrub} ppm/h. Earth's air has ≈ 420 ppm of CO₂.
energy.info.ls.3: Pressure: 101 kPa is sea level on Earth. The surface of Mars has less than 1 kPa: you could not breathe without the base.
energy.scrubber.msg_low: Filter nearly used up: swap it
energy.scrubber.msg_off: No power: it is not cleaning the air
energy.info.scrubber.title: CO₂ SCRUBBER
energy.info.scrubber.1: A filter lasts {hours} h of work. This one has {left} h left. Spares: {count}.
energy.info.scrubber.2: Spacecraft use lithium hydroxide (LiOH), which reacts with CO₂, or amine and zeolite beds that can be regenerated.
energy.info.scrubber.3: Too much CO₂ causes headaches and dizziness. In the game it is dangerous above {crit} ppm.
energy.o2.msg_ready: Open them only if oxygen runs low
energy.o2.msg_low: Low on O₂! Open a tank
energy.info.o2.title: OXYGEN TANKS
energy.info.o2.1: Each tank raises the base O₂ by {boost} points at once. It can only be used once.
energy.info.o2.2: The normal O₂ source is the electrolyzer (right next to it). The tanks are plan B if it fails or power runs out.
energy.info.thermo.title: THERMOSTAT
energy.info.thermo.1: Outside it is {ext} °C. The bigger the difference, the faster the base loses heat: at {ref} °C it loses {loss} °C per hour.
energy.info.thermo.2: The heater uses {kw} kW and adds +{heat} °C/h. A lower setpoint (minimum {min} °C) saves power, but below {cold} °C the crops grow more slowly.
energy.info.thermo.3: Hysteresis: the heater switches on {hyst} °C below the setpoint and off {hyst} °C above it, so it does not keep flicking on and off.
energy.solar.msg_sun: The panels are charging the battery
energy.solar.msg_turn: Turn the panels towards the Sun
energy.info.solar.title: SOLAR FIELD · DATA
energy.info.solar.1: A panel produces more the more squarely the Sun hits it: output is proportional to the cosine of the angle between panel and Sun.
energy.info.solar.2: Mars gets ≈ 43 % of the sunlight that reaches Earth. On top of that, settling dust covers the panels: Mars Pathfinder measured ≈ 0.28 % less per sol (Martian day).
energy.info.solar.clean: «Clean» fires an electric shield that pushes the dust off the panels (real NASA technology). It uses {kwh} kWh and does not work during a storm.
energy.info.breakers.tradeoff: Switching off saves battery, but it costs you: no light means no health recovery, cold makes crops grow slowly and without Telecom no warnings arrive.
cleaner.title: MARS-CLEANER ROVER
cleaner.info.capacity: Up to {max} panels per sortie; then it returns to the dock to recharge.
cleaner.selection.hint: Choose up to {max}; then it returns to recharge.
cleaner.selection.start: Start the shift to move the rover.
cleaner.selection.resume: Resume time to keep the rover moving.
